integrity: All analytical conclusions derive from the stated 2x2 Floquet characteristic polynomial and Schur root criterion. The accompanying finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite-time certificate. Priority remains subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic two-period positive steps for the naively scaled optimistic-gradient recurrence on a fixed 2D bilinear game; does not cover the adapted GRAAL algorithm, general schedules, or stochastic and nonlinear problems.
title: Sharp step-ratio resonance for two-period optimistic gradient on a bilinear saddle
